Action required: acknowledge your records

You must review and sign each pending paystub, terms update, or consent agreement before returning to other app features. Safety & emergency reporting remains available below.

Drivers on an active load or with an unresolved safety emergency may defer paystub sign-off once per payroll cycle for 12 hours. Other pending legal acknowledgements remain due.

The signed record includes the server timestamp, browser device ID, IP address observed by the app, and GPS coordinates when location is available and permitted. If you deny or cannot provide GPS, that is recorded and the signature can still be completed.

Location is requested when you sign. If unavailable or declined, the record will note that GPS was unavailable.

My paystubs, terms & consent

Salary advances are shown separately as “Salary Advance / Early Cashout”. Electronic signatures are timestamped and stored as encrypted, immutable PDFs.

You may contest a paystub until 48 hours before the salary release date at month-end. Submit any dispute through this portal before the displayed deadline.

HR records and your right to respond

You may submit one written rebuttal and supporting evidence within 72 hours. This response remains available while required payroll acknowledgements are pending.

Driver performance

Score = 0.35 × Safety + 0.30 × Customer Rating + 0.25 × On-Time Delivery − 0.10 × HR Infraction Penalty. HR infractions decay across a rolling 90-day window.

Shipment Tracking

Tracking access administration

Assign shipments to a client company and driver, or provision employee portal access.

Set the agreed contract rate before dispatch. Detention VAT is added at 16% on the invoice; zero means no detention fee.
See an auto-match example

Sample shipment: 12 tonnes, 15-ton truck, pickup at Athi River. A driver 4 km away with a GPS update from 5 minutes ago is selected ahead of a compatible driver 480 km away. A driver 1 km away with a GPS update older than 30 minutes is excluded. Real matching also checks active driver status, vehicle capacity/type, approved fleet certificates, and whether the driver has an active trip.

The shipment card includes trip BOL (with a QR code), a secure customer tracking link, and customer-email delivery when configured.

Pickup / delivery geofence and detention clock

Record arrival and departure using device GPS within 750 m of the configured freight-hub geofence. Detention accrues at the assigned contract rate for actual time on site.

Compatible loads and backhauls

Loads are filtered by your assigned truck type and capacity. Share your location only when you want proximity sorting; it expires after 30 minutes.
